# api-hardening

Opt-in API hardening: etcd encryption, audit profile, TLS security profiles, console banners and kubeadmin removal

Guide: https://policystk.io/elements/api-hardening/

Stability: preview ([Compatibility](https://policystk.io/reference/compatibility/#element-stability))

```yaml
stack:
  apiHardening:
    enabled: true
```

## Optional pieces

Shipped with `enabled: false`. Turn one on in a values layer.

| Entry | Description | Turn on with |
|---|---|---|
| template `config-apiserver-tls` | APIServer TLS security profile | `policies.config.templates.apiserver-tls.enabled: true` |
| template `config-audit-profile` | APIServer audit log profile | `policies.config.templates.audit-profile.enabled: true` |
| template `config-console-banners` | Web console notification banners | `policies.config.templates.console-banners.enabled: true` |
| template `config-etcd-encryption` | APIServer etcd encryption type | `policies.config.templates.etcd-encryption.enabled: true` |
| template `config-ingress-tls` | Default IngressController TLS security profile | `policies.config.templates.ingress-tls.enabled: true` |
| Policy [`kubeadmin`](#policy-kubeadmin) | Remove the kubeadmin user once an identity provider and a cluster-admin user exist | `policies.kubeadmin.enabled: true` |

## Settings

Each setting is applied only by its template, and every template ships enabled: false. The APIServer and IngressController templates write with musthave, so turning one off leaves the cluster as it is. Hosted control plane guests skip every object: set encryption, audit and the APIServer TLS profile on the HostedCluster; it has no console banner or ingress profile setting.

Under `stack.apiHardening.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `etcdEncryption` | APIServer spec.encryption.type: aesgcm, aescbc, or identity to decrypt | `aesgcm` |
| `auditProfile` | APIServer spec.audit.profile: Default, WriteRequestBodies or AllRequestBodies | `WriteRequestBodies` |
| `apiServerTLSProfile` | APIServer spec.tlsSecurityProfile type: Intermediate or Modern. The default IngressController follows it unless ingressTLSProfile is applied | `Intermediate` |
| `ingressTLSProfile` | Default IngressController spec.tlsSecurityProfile type: Intermediate or Modern | `Intermediate` |
| `consoleBanners` | ConsoleNotification name: {text, location, link: {href, text}, color, backgroundColor}. text is required, location is BannerTop (default), BannerBottom or BannerTopBottom, link.href starts with https://. The layer that turns console-banners on fills it | `{}` |
| `kubeadminRequireLogin` | kubeadmin removal also waits until a cluster-admin User, or a member of a cluster-admin Group, has logged in through a provider OAuth cluster lists, and the authentication ClusterOperator is Available, not Progressing and not Degraded | `false` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: SC-28 Protection of Information at Rest, AU-2 Event Logging, SC-8 Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity, AC-8 System Use Notification. Categories: SC System and Communications Protection, AU Audit and Accountability, AC Access Control.

### Policy `config`

`config-api-hardening-<cluster>`: API server, ingress and console hardening settings. Renders nothing by default: every template is off.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config-apiserver-tls` (off) | enforce | high | [apiserver-tls](converters/config/apiserver-tls.yaml) | APIServer TLS security profile |
| `config-audit-profile` (off) | enforce | high | [audit-profile](converters/config/audit-profile.yaml) | APIServer audit log profile |
| `config-console-banners` (off) | enforce | low | [console-banners](converters/config/console-banners.yaml) (mustonlyhave) | Web console notification banners |
| `config-etcd-encryption` (off) | enforce | high | [etcd-encryption](converters/config/etcd-encryption.yaml) | APIServer etcd encryption type |
| `config-ingress-tls` (off) | enforce | high | [ingress-tls](converters/config/ingress-tls.yaml) | Default IngressController TLS security profile |

### Policy `kubeadmin`

`kubeadmin-api-hardening-<cluster>`: Remove the kubeadmin user once an identity provider and a cluster-admin user exist. Off by default; turn on with `policies.kubeadmin.enabled: true`.

| Template | Action | Severity | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kubeadmin-absent` | inform (always) | high | [absent](converters/kubeadmin/absent.yaml) (mustnothave) | Reports NonCompliant while Secret kube-system/kubeadmin exists |
| `kubeadmin-removal` | enforce | high | [removal](converters/kubeadmin/removal.yaml) (mustnothave) | Deletes Secret kube-system/kubeadmin once an identity provider and a non-system cluster-admin binding exist |
